name: packtpublishing/cmake-best-practices---2nd-edition (book techniques): CMake parallel build job count (cmake --build --parallel N)
listed_description: Code a C++ book benchmarks or cites; see techniques. Technique: CMake parallel build job count (cmake --build --parallel N), --parallel 1 versus --parallel 4 on a small example project.
reason: No numeric comparison reachable and no benchmark code. The repo (MIT, 35 stars, last commit 2024-09-16) carries only the chapter02 example project (simple_example, component1, component2, component_interface, driver_app) and its README, which describe the project structure and C++11 requirement; there is no timing script, no benchmark, no recorded numbers and no mention of parallel builds anywhere in the README files. The book's job-count timings exist only as screenshots (not in text), so no number against the single-job baseline can be quoted. The technique is a command-line flag of cmake --build, not code in the repo, so no per-technique record was written.
